description: Fictional e-commerce company created for SemCache benchmarking

policies.answer: To track your order, log in to your ShopEase account, open My Orders, select the relevant order, and choose Track Order. You can view the tracking information available for that order.
Real-time order status requires access to the customer's actual order information. Please retrieve it through the authenticated order-tracking system.
To check your refund status, log in to your ShopEase account, open My Orders, select the relevant order, and view its Refund Status.
For this benchmark, ShopEase refunds are expected to reach the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days after refund approval.
Refund eligibility depends on the product and order conditions. Check the refund policy associated with your order or contact ShopEase support to confirm whether your purchase qualifies.

You can request cancellation from My Orders while your order is still awaiting dispatch. Once an order has been dispatched, it cannot be cancelled through the cancellation option. You may check the return procedure after delivery.
To change an existing shipping address, open My Orders, select your order, and check whether the Edit Address option is available. Address changes are permitted only before dispatch.
To add a new shipping address, log in to your ShopEase account, open Account Settings, select Saved Addresses, and choose Add New Address. Enter the address details and save them.
